entries.en: The fuddled guest struggled to remember his room number.
entries.zh: 那位喝醉的客人费力地回想着自己的房间号。

entries.en: The guards were forbidden to fraternise with the prisoners.
entries.zh: 守卫被禁止与囚犯亲近交往。

entries.en: Her imperiousness made even simple discussions feel like orders.
entries.zh: 她的专横让简单的讨论都像是在下命令。

entries.en: The character-at-a-time printer slowly produced the short report.
entries.zh: 字符打印机缓慢地打出了那份简短报告。

entries.en: All passengers were on board before the ferry departed.
entries.zh: 渡轮启航前，所有乘客都已上船。

entries.en: The attic feels kind of chilly this morning.
entries.zh: 今天早上阁楼里感觉有点冷。

entries.en: The crowd began to give tongue to its frustration.
entries.zh: 人群开始大声表达不满。

entries.en: The painting depicts the moment of truth in a bullfight.
entries.zh: 这幅画描绘了斗牛中刺出最后一剑的时刻。

entries.en: These disjunct fragments could not form a single coherent narrative.
entries.zh: 这些彼此分离的片段无法构成一段连贯的叙述。

entries.en: The fruit was bruised but still perfectly eatable.
entries.zh: 水果碰伤了，但仍然完全可以吃。

entries.en: We need to budget for replacing the worn carpet.
entries.zh: 我们需要为更换磨损的地毯编列预算。

entries.en: A volunteer's photograph was responsible for reuniting the lost dog with its owner.
entries.zh: 一位志愿者拍摄的照片让走失的狗得以与主人团聚。

entries.en: Local business people attended the workshop on shopfront design.
entries.zh: 当地商业人士参加了店面设计工作坊。

entries.en: A devoted family man, he reserved every Sunday for his children.
entries.zh: 他是个顾家的男人，每个星期天都留给孩子们。

entries.en: We should ask our new neighbors over for dinner.
entries.zh: 我们应该请新邻居来家里吃晚饭。

entries.en: Steam rose from the dunghill behind the stable.
entries.zh: 马厩后面的粪堆冒着热气。

entries.en: He laughed immoderately at the smallest joke.
entries.zh: 连最小的笑话都会让他笑个没完。

entries.en: The prolonged closure affected nearby shops detrimentally.
entries.zh: 长时间的关闭对附近商店造成了不利影响。

entries.en: The map shows the aircraft's line of flight across the bay.
entries.zh: 地图显示了飞机飞越海湾的航线。

entries.en: The pillar blocked my line of sight to the stage.
entries.zh: 柱子挡住了我看舞台的视线。

entries.en: She left the final page blank on purpose.
entries.zh: 她故意把最后一页留白。

entries.en: The taxi turned into a narrow one-way street.
entries.zh: 出租车拐进了一条狭窄的单行道。

entries.en: His unusual turn of phrase made the letter memorable.
entries.zh: 他那不寻常的措辞让这封信令人难忘。

entries.en: The collector displayed a piece of eight beside other silver coins.
entries.zh: 收藏家把一枚西班牙古银币与其他银币摆在一起展示。

entries.en: The weightiness of the box surprised the delivery driver.
entries.zh: 这个箱子的沉重让送货司机吃了一惊。

entries.en: The missing value is deducible from the remaining measurements.
entries.zh: 缺失的数值可以从其余测量结果推算出来。

entries.en: A lidless jar stood beside the artist's brushes.
entries.zh: 一个无盖罐子放在画家的画笔旁。

entries.en: The heavy beams rest on two stone pillars.
entries.zh: 沉重的横梁搁在两根石柱上。

entries.en: The fund will pay out small grants to local groups.
entries.zh: 该基金将向当地团体支付小额补助。

entries.en: Ignoring the loose wheel would be to ask for trouble.
entries.zh: 不理会松动的车轮就是自找麻烦。

entries.en: She stitched the entire border by hand.
entries.zh: 她用手缝好了整圈边饰。

entries.en: The ferry was already under way when we reached the pier.
entries.zh: 我们到码头时，渡轮已经启航了。

entries.en: The story gives the captive a chance to confront his tormenter.
entries.zh: 故事给了俘虏一个面对折磨者的机会。

entries.en: The cumbrous wooden frame barely fitted through the doorway.
entries.zh: 那个笨重的木框勉强能通过门口。

entries.en: The solicitor checked the signed power of attorney.
entries.zh: 律师核查了签字的授权委托书。

entries.en: A loyal company man, he defended every management decision.
entries.zh: 他是个忠于公司的雇员，为管理层的每项决定辩护。

entries.en: We began to lose sight of the boat in the fog.
entries.zh: 雾中，我们渐渐看不见那条船了。

entries.en: The manager wanted more face time with the remote team.
entries.zh: 经理希望有更多时间与远程团队当面相处。

entries.meaningZh: 对（某事或做某事）予以注意
entries.en: The next lesson will focus on sentence structure.
entries.zh: 下一课将重点关注句子结构。

entries.en: Could you put in a good word for the new assistant?
entries.zh: 你能为那位新助理说句好话吗？

entries.en: The salutatorian welcomed families at the start of the graduation ceremony.
entries.zh: 毕业典礼开始时，致欢迎辞的优秀毕业生向家属们表示欢迎。

entries.en: The therapist prepared picture cards for an aphasic patient.
entries.zh: 治疗师为一位失语患者准备了图片卡片。

entries.en: The teacher used a rolling cart to illustrate the first law of motion.
entries.zh: 老师用一辆滚动的小车说明运动第一定律。

entries.en: Her sense of responsibility kept her checking every detail.
entries.zh: 她的责任感促使她不断检查每个细节。

entries.en: We decided to push on before the daylight faded.
entries.zh: 我们决定趁天还没黑继续赶路。

entries.en: The younger players look up to their patient captain.
entries.zh: 年轻球员们都敬仰那位耐心的队长。

entries.en: Many another visitor has admired the same view.
entries.zh: 一个又一个的游客都曾欣赏过同样的景色。

entries.en: A strong sense of duty brought him back to help.
entries.zh: 强烈的责任感使他回来帮忙。

entries.en: The architect proposed to crenellate the top of the garden wall.
entries.zh: 建筑师提议把花园围墙的顶部修成雉堞状。

entries.en: Her letters mingled affection with playful coquetry.
entries.zh: 她的信中既有爱意，也有俏皮的撒娇。

entries.en: The little bucket was brimful of rainwater.
entries.zh: 那个小桶装满了雨水，水一直到桶沿。

entries.en: Calling the city a jungle is a figure of speech.
entries.zh: 把城市称为丛林是一种修辞手法。

entries.en: She hopes to make it as a professional illustrator.
entries.zh: 她希望能成为一名成功的职业插画师。

entries.en: He believed body and soul in the rescue project.
entries.zh: 他全心全意地相信这个救援项目。

entries.en: The census form asks for the head of household.
entries.zh: 人口普查表要求填写户主的信息。

entries.en: The room was bright, spacious, and affordable to boot.
entries.zh: 房间明亮又宽敞，而且价格也能负担。

entries.en: It is unkind to laugh at someone else's mistakes.
entries.zh: 嘲笑别人的错误是不友善的。

entries.en: She knows the entire opening speech by heart.
entries.zh: 她把整段开场致辞都背下来了。

entries.en: We took the funicular up the steep hillside.
entries.zh: 我们乘缆索铁路登上了陡峭的山坡。

entries.en: Her assiduity gradually transformed the neglected archive.
entries.zh: 她的勤勉逐渐改变了那个疏于管理的档案馆。

entries.en: His excellent sense of direction helped us find the trail.
entries.zh: 他出色的方向感帮助我们找到了步道。

entries.en: The handle may come away if you pull too hard.
entries.zh: 如果拉得太用力，把手可能会脱落。

entries.en: The empty seats send a message about public dissatisfaction.
entries.zh: 空着的座位传达了公众不满的信息。

entries.en: The chart compares two versions of the system of measurement.
entries.zh: 图表比较了这种单位制的两个版本。

entries.en: The engineer tested the audibility of announcements at the platform's far end.
entries.zh: 工程师测试了站台最远端能否听清广播。

entries.en: The diagram shows an occlusive blockage inside the vessel.
entries.zh: 图中显示了血管内部造成闭塞的堵塞物。

entries.en: The medical textbook includes a chapter on thrombophlebitis.
entries.zh: 这本医学教材包含一章关于血栓静脉炎的内容。

entries.en: A committed party man, he rarely questioned the official position.
entries.zh: 他是个坚定的忠诚党员，很少质疑党的正式立场。

entries.en: The old school preferred handwritten letters to telephone calls.
entries.zh: 守旧派更喜欢手写信，而不是打电话。

entries.en: The screen shows changes in water level in real time.
entries.zh: 屏幕实时显示水位变化。

entries.en: She is cautious by nature and checks every route.
entries.zh: 她天生谨慎，会检查每条路线。

entries.en: The map marks the northern sea as a theatre of war.
entries.zh: 地图把北部海域标为战区。

entries.en: The flooded bridge forced us, of necessity, to take a detour.
entries.zh: 桥被洪水淹没，我们不得不绕道。

entries.en: The diagram shows a ternary system with three interacting components.
entries.zh: 图中展示了一个由三个相互作用的部分组成的系统。

entries.en: The fictional guard tried to draw a bead on the charging beast.
entries.zh: 那名虚构的守卫试图瞄准冲来的野兽。

entries.en: The survey begins with a simple yes-no question.
entries.zh: 调查以一个简单的是非题开始。

entries.en: The small team proved adequate to the challenging task.
entries.zh: 这个小团队证明自己能胜任这项艰巨任务。

entries.en: The stage crew will black out the hall between scenes.
entries.zh: 舞台工作人员会在换场时熄灭大厅灯光。

entries.en: She set aside a small sum of money for repairs.
entries.zh: 她留出一小笔钱用于维修。

entries.en: The technician measured the water's rate of flow through the pipe.
entries.zh: 技术员测量了水流过管道时的流量。

entries.en: The anatomy diagram uses oculus as the label for the eye.
entries.zh: 这幅解剖图用 oculus 标注眼睛。

entries.en: The actor whispered a conjuration before opening the painted door.
entries.zh: 演员低声念了一段咒文，然后打开那扇彩绘门。

entries.en: The paddlewheel churned the muddy water behind the boat.
entries.zh: 明轮在船后搅动着浑浊的河水。

entries.en: Visitors may move between the exhibition rooms at will.
entries.zh: 游客可以随意在展厅之间走动。

entries.en: Keep a notebook at hand during the interview.
entries.zh: 采访时，把笔记本放在手边。

entries.en: We waited for the all clear before returning to the building.
entries.zh: 我们等到解除警报后才返回大楼。

entries.en: She spent her day off working in the garden.
entries.zh: 她在休息日里做园艺。

entries.en: We can adjust the plan as we go along.
entries.zh: 我们可以在进行过程中调整计划。

entries.en: His main point failed to get across during the noisy meeting.
entries.zh: 会议太吵，他的主要意思没能被理解。

entries.en: Scouts checked the line of march before the column advanced.
entries.zh: 纵队前进之前，侦察兵检查了行军路线。

entries.en: The two confluent streams formed a wider river below the bridge.
entries.zh: 两条合流的溪水在桥下汇成了一条更宽的河。

entries.en: He dipped the pen into a small glass inkpot.
entries.zh: 他把笔蘸进一个小玻璃墨水壶。

entries.en: The ceremony included the conferral of several honorary degrees.
entries.zh: 仪式包括了几个荣誉学位的授予。

entries.en: The program uses a system call to request access to the file.
entries.zh: 程序通过系统调用请求访问该文件。

entries.en: These damaged roads cry for immediate repairs.
entries.zh: 这些受损道路迫切需要立即修复。

entries.en: We should keep back a few blankets for late arrivals.
entries.zh: 我们应该留几条毯子给晚到的人。

entries.en: The exercise asks students to calculate the annual rate of inflation.
entries.zh: 这道练习要求学生计算年度通货膨胀率。

entries.en: The forged invitation nearly let him put one across on us.
entries.zh: 那封伪造的邀请函差点让他骗过了我们。

entries.en: The doctor checked the otoscope before examining the child's ear.
entries.zh: 医生检查了耳镜，然后查看孩子的耳朵。

entries.en: The novel's opening imagines a dreamworld of floating gardens.
entries.zh: 小说的开篇想象了一个漂浮花园构成的梦幻世界。

entries.en: They used to gad about town on sunny afternoons.
entries.zh: 他们过去常在晴朗的下午到城里闲逛。

entries.en: A passing bus briefly blocked her line of vision.
entries.zh: 一辆经过的公共汽车短暂地挡住了她的视线。

entries.en: The memoir describes his years as a prisoner of war.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录描述了他当战俘的那些年。

entries.en: We had to paint the uneven wall over again.
entries.zh: 我们不得不重新粉刷那面颜色不均的墙。

entries.en: It is hard to conceive of the square without its fountain.
entries.zh: 很难想象这个广场没有喷泉会是什么样子。

entries.en: The state government approved funding for repairs to the bridge.
entries.zh: 州政府批准了修桥资金。

entries.en: The judgment separates each factual finding from its conclusion of law.
entries.zh: 判决书把每项事实认定与相应的法律结论分开列出。

entries.en: The medical history exhibit included early accounts of beriberi.
entries.zh: 医学史展览包括了早期对脚气病的记载。

entries.en: An eery silence settled over the deserted platform.
entries.zh: 一片令人毛骨悚然的寂静笼罩了空无一人的站台。

entries.en: A bewhiskered fisherman waved from the little boat.
entries.zh: 一位满脸胡须的渔民从小船上挥手。

entries.en: You have watered the seedlings too much this week.
entries.zh: 你这周给幼苗浇水太多了。

entries.en: The essay examines how one-man rule weakened local institutions.
entries.zh: 这篇文章探讨了独裁统治如何削弱地方机构。

entries.en: Please hang on while I check the timetable.
entries.zh: 请不要挂断，我查一下时刻表。

entries.en: She works alone by choice rather than necessity.
entries.zh: 她独自工作是自己的选择，并非迫不得已。

entries.en: We decided to sit out the long ceremony.
entries.zh: 我们决定一直坐到漫长的仪式结束。

entries.en: Despite his grumbling, he is a generous person at heart.
entries.zh: 尽管他爱发牢骚，但他内心是个慷慨的人。

entries.en: We had time to walk about before the museum opened.
entries.zh: 博物馆开门前，我们有时间到处走走。

entries.en: The proposal would denationalize the state-owned transport company.
entries.zh: 这项提案将使那家国有运输公司转为私有。

entries.en: He officiously rearranged everyone's chairs without being asked.
entries.zh: 没人请他帮忙，他却多管闲事地重新摆放了所有人的椅子。

entries.en: A few flowers could prettify the bare entrance.
entries.zh: 几盆花就能美化这个光秃秃的入口。

entries.en: The child began to pull at a loose thread.
entries.zh: 孩子开始用手扯一根松线。

entries.en: Do not give away the surprise before Saturday.
entries.zh: 星期六之前不要泄露这个惊喜。

entries.en: They spent a week walking through the remote back country.
entries.zh: 他们花了一周徒步穿越偏远的内陆地区。

entries.en: The exhibit lets visitors explore texture through their sense of touch.
entries.zh: 这个展项让游客通过触觉探索质地。

entries.en: She joined the school orchestra during high school.
entries.zh: 她在中学期间加入了学校管弦乐队。

entries.en: The exercise challenged his sense of balance on the narrow beam.
entries.zh: 这项练习在窄梁上考验了他的平衡觉。

entries.en: The fence was shoddily built and soon began to lean.
entries.zh: 这道篱笆建造得很粗劣，很快就开始倾斜。

entries.en: The trader added a small stone as a makeweight.
entries.zh: 商人加了一块小石头来补足重量。

entries.en: The distressful letter left her unable to concentrate.
entries.zh: 那封令人苦恼的信让她无法集中注意力。

entries.en: The yellow door makes the house stand out.
entries.zh: 黄色的大门让这幢房子格外显眼。

entries.en: The diagram marks the centre of mass with a red dot.
entries.zh: 图中用一个红点标出了质心。

entries.meaningZh: 排在行或列中最末端的人
entries.en: The end man in the row held the team's flag.
entries.zh: 队列最末端的那名男子举着队旗。

entries.en: The new ticketing system is on trial this month.
entries.zh: 新的售票系统本月正在试用。

entries.en: She would make as if to leave, then turn back smiling.
entries.zh: 她会装作要离开，然后微笑着转身回来。

entries.en: The committee must dispose of the remaining complaints before Friday.
entries.zh: 委员会必须在周五前处理完剩余投诉。

entries.meaningZh: 将法案提交大会并附审查报告
entries.en: The committee voted to report out the revised bill.
entries.zh: 委员会投票决定将修订后的法案附审查报告提交大会。

entries.en: The wounded beast collapsed after the hunter's final deathblow.
entries.zh: 受伤的野兽在猎人最后的致命一击后倒下。

entries.en: The pharmacist checked the diazepam package against the inventory.
entries.zh: 药剂师对照库存清单检查了地西泮包装。

entries.en: A gelid wind swept across the empty platform.
entries.zh: 一阵冰冷的风扫过空荡荡的站台。

entries.en: I do not care a hang about the curtains' color.
entries.zh: 我根本不在乎窗帘是什么颜色。

entries.en: I will not break my back over an unnecessary report.
entries.zh: 我不会为一份没必要的报告拼命苦干。

entries.en: The teacher asked for an explanation and received only back talk.
entries.zh: 老师要求解释，得到的却只有顶嘴。

entries.en: He signed a note of hand promising payment in June.
entries.zh: 他签了一张亲笔期票，承诺六月付款。

entries.en: On the face of it, the two proposals look similar.
entries.zh: 乍看起来，这两个提案很相似。

entries.en: A minister of religion led the short service in the chapel.
entries.zh: 一位牧师在小教堂主持了简短的礼拜。

entries.en: The proposal may come in for criticism at the meeting.
entries.zh: 这项提案可能会在会上遭到批评。

entries.en: The host bountifully supplied food for every guest.
entries.zh: 主人慷慨地为每位客人提供了食物。

entries.en: A charwoman came each Friday to clean the offices.
entries.zh: 一位按日雇用的女清洁工每周五来打扫办公室。

entries.en: The committee interpreted the eligibility rule restrictively.
entries.zh: 委员会对资格规则作了限制性的解释。

entries.en: We cannot afford to get behind with the repairs.
entries.zh: 我们不能让维修进度落后。

entries.en: You can drop by after lunch if you like.
entries.zh: 如果愿意，你可以午饭后顺便过来。

entries.en: The flooded path forced us to turn back.
entries.zh: 小路被淹，我们不得不往回走。

entries.en: The exporter requested a letter of credit from the buyer's bank.
entries.zh: 出口商要求买方银行开具信用证。

entries.en: The sermon discussed the Christian idea of a state of grace.
entries.zh: 讲道讨论了基督教中蒙受天恩这一概念。

entries.en: The hilltop offered a defendable position overlooking the road.
entries.zh: 山顶提供了一个俯瞰道路、易于防守的位置。

entries.en: The carpenter will chamfer the edge of the wooden panel.
entries.zh: 木匠将把木板的边缘削成斜角。

entries.en: The semiotician studied the changing meanings of street signs.
entries.zh: 符号学者研究了街头标志不断变化的意义。

entries.en: The coach had to tell him off for arriving late.
entries.zh: 教练不得不因他迟到而责备他。

entries.en: We requested another meeting to buy time for negotiations.
entries.zh: 我们要求再开一次会，为谈判争取时间。

entries.en: The team will carry out the survey next week.
entries.zh: 团队将于下周开展这项调查。

entries.en: The missing key had been in my pocket all along.
entries.zh: 那把找不到的钥匙一直在我的口袋里。

entries.en: We should talk over the details before booking.
entries.zh: 预订前，我们应该详细讨论一下。

entries.en: Until now, we have never needed a larger storeroom.
entries.zh: 到现在为止，我们从未需要过更大的储藏室。

entries.en: The parish lay within a large rural archdeaconry.
entries.zh: 这个教区位于一个面积很大的乡村会吏总监察区内。

entries.en: Thick mist began to enwrap the little village.
entries.zh: 浓雾开始笼罩这个小村庄。

entries.en: The case notes recorded that he could not expectorate the phlegm.
entries.zh: 病例记录记载他无法咳出痰液。

entries.en: The presenter seemed more relaxed on camera this evening.
entries.zh: 这位主持人今晚在镜头前显得更放松。

entries.en: We watched the truck slowly back off the narrow ramp.
entries.zh: 我们看着卡车慢慢从狭窄的坡道倒退下来。

entries.en: The jeweler displayed diamonds of the first water.
entries.zh: 珠宝商展示了品质最上乘的钻石。

entries.en: The sleeping dog began to turn over on the rug.
entries.zh: 睡着的狗开始在地毯上翻身。

entries.en: The lesson illustrates a law of motion using a moving cart.
entries.zh: 这节课用一辆运动的小车说明一条运动定律。

entries.en: She seemed to walk on air after winning the award.
entries.zh: 获奖后，她似乎高兴得飘飘然了。
